name: AI Model Retirement Lint
subtitle: Finds the LLM model IDs pinned in your code that vendors have already switched off, or have dated to switch off, with the replacement and the date.
free: Checks the file you have open against all 33 rules and names every retired or expiring model ID, its date and the vendor's replacement - no key, no limit, no watermark.
paid: Scans every file in the repository, emits CI output that fails the build before a dead model ID can merge, and applies the vendor's replacement in place.
need_key: This option needs a licence (AI Model Retirement Lint).
